bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Class Mammalia is defined by milk-producing mammary glands, keratin hair, endothermic warm-blooded metabolism, and a muscular diaphragm.
core_mechanism_bullets: Class Mammalia is defined by milk-producing mammary glands, keratin hair, endothermic warm-blooded metabolism, and a muscular diaphragm.
Mammalian osteology features a single lower jawbone (dentary) and 3 middle-ear ossicles called the malleus, incus, and stapes.
